verdict: PA-01 is not certifiable as a whole at 0f9989a, and the reason is not the software. Eight criteria were driven to a verdict and none of them failed; criteria 1 and 2 have nothing to drive because there is no deploy script, no host, no certificate and no DNS name, and ALPHA_ROADMAP.md section 9 still lists those as owed by the owner. The application that exists behind that gap does what the checkpoint asks of it, including the two things the programme had most reason to doubt: a client can now watch a run go from running to published, and a wiped instance restored from its own dump accepts the next upload of its own bytes.
